label: Demo: charger failure
engineer_report: Pick station 3 has been idle for 12 minutes. Operators are waiting for totes.
expected_cause: Charger C2 contactor fault (CHG-214 at 14:02) while C4 is in planned maintenance (CHG-250 since 12:30). G3 robots can only charge on C2/C4, so 5 of 7 G3 robots are queued in CHG-EAST at 13-14% battery and R17/R20 are blocked in the east charging corridor behind them. No G3 robot is available, so PS3 gets no totes after 14:09:41.
expected_evidence: R15, R16, R18, R19, R21 QUEUED_CHARGE in CHG-EAST
R17, R20 BLOCKED AMR-207 in CHG-CORR-E
WCS-430 pending tasks for PS3 from 14:11
traps: INC-0137 has the same symptom (PS3 idle) but a scanner cause; there totes were arriving
WCS-402 reject for PS5 at 14:05 is unrelated

label: Blocked aisle
engineer_report: Station 1 has slowed right down and I think a robot is stuck in aisle A04.
expected_cause: R07 emergency stop for safety field obstruction (AMR-305) in aisle A04 at 09:41; R03 and R05 are blocked behind it (AMR-207).
expected_evidence: R03, R05 BLOCKED AMR-207 in A04

label: Message rejects
engineer_report: Stations 4 and 6 are short of work and the WCS screen is full of red errors.
expected_cause: WMS slotting batch SLT-8841 at 16:15 re-coded L-07-* locations before the WCS location master was synchronised, so tasks are rejected with WCS-402.

label: Low battery
engineer_report: A robot has stopped in transit lane TR-2 and is blocking traffic.
expected_cause: R31 stopped at 10% battery (AMR-112). Its charge request at 15% was lost during the fleet manager restart at 05:41-05:43.

label: Conveyor jam
engineer_report: PS5 keeps pausing because it cannot send totes away.
expected_cause: Repeated jam at conveyor merge M2 (photo-eye PE-M2-03, CNV-501) filling the PS5 outbound spur. Fourth occurrence; MR-2207 bracket replacement still open.
